title: kblint machine-readable claim entry
description: One durable repository-knowledge claim with its scope, evidence, invalidation condition and an audit-produced status. Status is generated by a deterministic audit, never self-asserted; last_checked records when an audit last looked, not that the claim was verified.

claim_id.description: Stable identifier for the claim (e.g. ENV-003 or r49-step-ms).

claim.description: The checkable statement: a number, pin, path, target, convention or negative result.

repository.description: Repository or project the claim applies to (no absolute local paths).

version.description: Commit, release, or date range the evidence applies to.

environment.description: Optional environment qualifier (GPU model, OS, dependency set, ...).

command.description: Command that re-derives or checks the claim (required for command evidence).

test.description: Test selector, e.g. tests/test_pins.py::test_torch_pin (required for test evidence).

condition.description: The condition that makes the claim stale (env change, artifact update, dependency bump, owner change, date/expiry).

status.description: Generated by the audit: verified (evidence re-resolved), stale (evidence contradicts), unknown (not checkable from the repo), removed (claim retired).

last_checked.description: When an audit last evaluated the claim. This is a timestamp of inspection, not a verification result; status carries the result.
